name: cross-file-stale-caller
description: store.go changes the unit of Save's and Touch's ttl from seconds to milliseconds (SETEX/EXPIRE become SET PX/PEXPIRE). manager.go, in the same PR, converts the stored idle timeout correctly but adds Hold, which still passes int64(d.Seconds()) to Touch. Nothing in manager.go alone is wrong: the call only reads as a bug against the new contract in store.go, which is what makes this a cross-file case.

expected.why: Touch now takes milliseconds, so a hold of two hours sets a lifetime of 7.2 seconds and the session expires while the export it was meant to cover is still running.
